description: This file provides utility classes and functions for interfacing with Google's Gemini language models within the Litellm framework. It includes model validation, API interaction, error handling, and token counting functionalities, as well as serialization support for various data types.

classes.name: GeminiError
classes.description: Custom exception class for Gemini-related errors, inheriting from BaseLLMException.

classes.name: GeminiModelInfo
classes.description: Provides methods for validating environment, retrieving model info, and handling API interactions with Gemini models.

classes.name: GoogleAIStudioTokenCounter
classes.description: Implements token counting for Google AI Studio, supporting asynchronous token counting based on provided model and message data.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates headers and settings for API environment; specifically noting that API key is sent in query parameters.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_api_base(api_base: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves the API base URL, falling back to environment secrets or default URL.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_api_key(api_key: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves the API key from provided argument or environment secrets.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_base_model(model: str)
methods.description: Strips 'gemini/' prefix from model name to return base model identifier.

methods.name: List[str] process_model_name(self, models: List[Dict[str, str]])
methods.description: Processes list of models to prepend 'gemini/' after removing 'models/' prefix.

methods.name: List[str] get_models( self, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Fetches available Gemini models from the API endpoint, raising errors if unsuccessful.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Creates and returns a GeminiError exception for failed API calls.

methods.name: Optional[BaseTokenCounter] get_token_counter(self)
methods.description: Factory method to create a token counter for Gemini provider.

methods.name: Dict[str,object] encode_unserializable_types( data: Dict[str, object], depth: int = 0 )
methods.description: Converts unserializable data types (bytes, datetime) within a dict to JSON-compatible types, with depth control.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_api_key_from_env()
methods.description: Utility to obtain API key from environment secrets.

methods.name: Optional[TokenCountResponse] count_tokens( self, model_to_use: str, messages: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]], contents: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]], deployment: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, request_model: str = "", )
